title: Omniverse Asset Manifest
description: Versioned manifest mapping DSL classes and elements to referenced Omniverse USD assets.

defaults.description: Per-class asset mapping, keyed by DSL class name.

overrides.description: Per-element asset mapping, keyed by element name. Wins over defaults.

asset.description: Path to the USD asset, relative to the asset root.

scaleMode.description: How the referenced asset is scaled. 'uniform' applies uniformScale (for pre-sized assets). 'fit' scales a 1 m unit asset to the element's modelled length/width/height.

uniformScale.description: Uniform scale factor applied to the referenced asset.

rotateXDeg.description: Rotation about the X axis, in degrees, applied to the referenced asset.

zOffsetM.description: Additional Z offset, in meters, applied to the referenced asset.
